knowledge-graph-tool-free 1.0.0

- Initial release providing an embedded personal knowledge graph tool for single-agent use.
- Stores knowledge graph in local JSON files with basic CRUD (create, read, update, delete) support for entities and relationships.
- Offers compact KGML summaries automatically injected into session context for persistent long-term memory.
- Includes command-line scripts for querying, updating, and summarizing the knowledge graph.
- Designed for personal knowledge management, structured note-taking, and persistent conversational memory.
